critiques.subject: Close-up of a fluffy white dog with its tongue out being held/squeezed gently by a person’s hands
improvements: [MODERATE] Increase overall exposure slightly (+0.3 to +0.6) and lift shadows (+15 to +30) while pulling highlights down slightly (-10 to -20) to keep the white fur from washing out
[MODERATE] Apply selective sharpening to the dog’s eyes and nose (masking heavily; small radius) and add subtle texture/clarity to fur (+5 to +15), avoiding the background and hands
[SUBTLE] Use local adjustments to brighten the eyes (small brush: +0.2 exposure, +10 shadows) and add subtle catchlight/contrast with a gentle curves tweak on the face
[MODERATE] Reduce noise in midtones/shadows (luminance NR ~15–30) and apply color noise reduction (~20–30), then reintroduce fine detail only on the dog with masking
[SUBTLE] Crop slightly tighter and/or straighten to center attention on the dog’s face; consider trimming some empty background at top/left while keeping tongue and ears within frame

[SUBTLE] Cool the white balance slightly and reduce yellow/orange saturation in the background (Temp -200 to -500K; HSL Yellow/Orange Sat -10 to -25) while keeping the dog’s fur neutral

[MODERATE] Selective sharpening and clarity on facial features: mask the dog’s eyes/nose/mouth (Sharpening amount +20 to +40 with Masking 70+; Texture +10 to +20; add subtle eye catchlight/iris contrast with a local brush)

[SUBTLE] Crop slightly tighter and remove/soften distracting areas (dark patch at bottom, busy color blobs in background) using crop + subtle vignette (-5 to -15) and/or content-aware/heal on small distractions
[SUBTLE] Reduce saturation of the hands/nails slightly (HSL Reds Sat -10 to -20; Orange Sat -5 to -15) and lightly smooth blotchy skin tones if needed (local brush Texture -5 to -10)

Playful expression and bright, airy feel
critiques.notes: Strong, charming pet portrait with pleasing background blur and a great expression. Main opportunities are recovering detail in the bright white fur, slightly neutralizing the warm cast, and adding selective crispness to the eyes/nose for stronger focus.

improvements_detailed.action: Reduce highlights/whites on the dog's fur (Highlights -20 to -40, Whites -10 to -25) and add a mild tone curve to protect detail while keeping the image bright
improvements_detailed.reason: The white fur is close to clipping and looks a bit flat; recovering highlight detail adds texture and depth without changing the joyful look.

improvements_detailed.action: Cool the white balance slightly and reduce yellow/orange saturation in the background (Temp -200 to -500K; HSL Yellow/Orange Sat -10 to -25) while keeping the dog’s fur neutral
improvements_detailed.reason: The overall warmth makes the whites look creamy and the background color competes with the subject; a small correction improves color separation and cleanliness.

improvements_detailed.action: Selective sharpening and clarity on facial features: mask the dog’s eyes/nose/mouth (Sharpening amount +20 to +40 with Masking 70+; Texture +10 to +20; add subtle eye catchlight/iris contrast with a local brush)
improvements_detailed.reason: The image reads slightly soft; targeted detail work draws attention to the eyes and nose without over-sharpening the fur or skin tones.

improvements_detailed.action: Crop slightly tighter and remove/soften distracting areas (dark patch at bottom, busy color blobs in background) using crop + subtle vignette (-5 to -15) and/or content-aware/heal on small distractions
improvements_detailed.reason: A cleaner frame and darker edges keep focus on the dog’s expression and reduce background pull.

improvements_detailed.action: Reduce saturation of the hands/nails slightly (HSL Reds Sat -10 to -20; Orange Sat -5 to -15) and lightly smooth blotchy skin tones if needed (local brush Texture -5 to -10)
improvements_detailed.reason: The red nails and warm skin tones are visually strong and can steal attention from the face; dialing them back keeps the dog as the clear focal point.
